description:
FILED s473t4 (#1501 CHECK 1 round 1, 2026-09-13).  Census finding: `Undefined subroutine &main::_create_runperl called` aborts a top-level form of t/io/fflush.t (3 rows short).

perl's t/test.pl `_create_runperl` builds the SHELL COMMAND STRING that `runperl` then qx()es -- switches, -e programs, stdin pipes, 2>&1 redirection, VMS/Win32 quoting.  PCL's stub (perl-tests/t/test.pl) does not build a command string at all: its `runperl`/`runperl_and_capture` route the child through $ENV{PCLPERL} (tools/pclperl-for-tests) with an argv, which is why a transpiled harness can run perl's children under PCL (task #348).

So this is NOT "copy the sub over": a verbatim `_create_runperl` would return a command line naming a perl the stub never runs.  A caller that wants the STRING (io/fflush.t builds one and then appends its own redirection) needs either
  (a) a `_create_runperl` in the stub that builds the same string around $ENV{PCLPERL}, or
  (b) the caller routed through the stub's own runperl.
(a) is the honest one -- it is the same "one mechanism, asked by two callers" shape as the rest of the stub.

VALUE: 3 rows.  Filler.  Filed so the census can attribute `undef-fn:main::_create_runperl` instead of leaving it UNEXPLAINED.


=== DONE (s484d, shipped; bars re-measured s486c on the rebased tree) ===

`_create_runperl` added to the PCL test.pl stub on its existing child
mechanism.  io/fflush.t **DIFF 4/0 -> OK 7/0** -- the file runs to the end, and
its three blessed fail rows left `baselines/perl-suite-fails.tsv` by EDIT.  Its
row-shortfall entry goes to zero.  Measured `--jobs 1` with the #366 serial
re-run agreeing, against a `git archive f6b56feb` extraction.

BARS on the combined tree (s486c, rebased onto main 4429126a): gate
`Result: PASS` 243 files / 8216 rows; full perl-tests sweep GATE clean,
0 new / 0 fixed, TOTAL passing 18681 = 18681 (+0), drops 5 = census.
Companion `--all --quick --jobs 2`: see the s486c record.
